evidence: Current policy controls interpretation: qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13 says 'Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping' and requires separate credit for separately useful promises while sharing setup. The workbook's Quality Checks!D29 prohibits duplicate/subsuming/incompatible criteria; Internal Quality Checks!E29 permits shared flows, not the waiver of the newer policy. The ordinary criteria generally respect this: functional/judge.toml:812,821,830 separate action-specific audit lines, :848,857,866 separate structured snapshots, and :875 separates historical immutability; the functional prompt expressly preserves independent observations and Visual prohibits repeated deductions for one defect. However, three coordinated criteria retain materially independent conjunctive outcomes. (1) functional/judge.toml:965, hro_change_preview_neutral, requires both 'saved preview survives fresh signed-in readback' and unchanged economic/history state in one binary row. Durable draft storage and deferring economic effects are independent useful promises in public hireops_rules.md:437-440. (2) functional/judge.toml:1055, hro_change_receipt, combines the durable batch receipt, each member's audit line/after-image, and later historical immutability in one binary row. Public hireops_rules.md:467-470 asks for the member artifacts 'plus' a batch receipt. A missing member human-readable line need not invalidate an otherwise fully useful saved batch receipt or structured member snapshot. The same distinction is already honored for ordinary actions elsewhere in this rubric. (3) functional/judge.toml:1082, hro_change_later_destination, combines subsequent destination-budget replacement/release and original-date vesting. Public hireops_rules.md:464-465 states both promises; correct requisition accounting remains independently useful when the vesting calculation uses the wrong anchor, and vice versa. Generic independent-scoring wording cannot produce partial credit inside these binary rows. Parsed current functional TOML has 133 criteria totaling 45.0 weight; each identified row has weight 1.0, so together they control 0.04 of maximum shaped reward above the functional floor under unchanged functional weight 0.6. This is source arithmetic, not an observed judge score. No inherent incompatible-product pair or material duplicate penalty was established after applying the explicit ownership exclusions; the failure is the remaining partial-credit bundling under the current policy. Reviewed source SHA256 values were computed directly: workbook 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f; skill 8f2b660d1d32df90eb50990f401a0fc23a2ccbbcd49eeb5730bfbb9bef2bebc3; functional judge 49c966b92b91a70e6e2e89d3eb2c1a16d80029a743a3df894265deacf4eeec49; functional prompt 9b8ab2dd2ba5e44d5f4d894839ecc9c7ab82a5f18bc618e5a91d9a5cffb36048; public rules 3524e05b02f6c854699b698f298932240e14912775149b620a7ec257622cb79d; current policy 9fa534809d9d5ddb99b141c7ee213bae35006ef49c7af4be0a6b14bbbbaf7b5b. No Docker/provider run was made, no other reviewer report was read, and no runtime observation is claimed.
counterexample: Source-derived partial-app witnesses, not executed model runs: A working Finance preview is saved durably and freshly readable but wrongly reserves a commitment at prepare time; it receives zero for hro_change_preview_neutral, as does a correct non-reserving preview whose fresh-session retrieval alone is broken, losing the independently established counterpart. A batch commits correctly and provides a durable, immutable, complete batch receipt plus accurate structured member snapshots but omits the human-readable member audit lines; hro_change_receipt gives no credit for the complete receipt/snapshot capabilities. A transferred hire's later revision and rescission correctly charge/release the destination only, but rescission computes vesting from the transfer time instead of the preserved original start; hro_change_later_destination gives no credit for correct post-transfer budget ownership. Reversing each isolated defect exhibits the reciprocal useful outcome. These are failures of independent credit rather than arguments to excuse the actual defects. Broken-app challenge: the explicit successful controls and fresh readbacks prevent a dead preview/commit from passing these rows; splitting must retain those controls. Conforming-alternative challenge: a product using generated IDs, different ordinary form/receipt layouts, semantic date/money representations, and explicit refresh controls preserving drafts is accepted by the ownership and representation clauses; no new layout/route demand or contrary conforming-product failure is alleged here.
suggested_fix: Keep the shared B1/B6 browser scenarios and combined weights, but assign separate binary observations for preview persistence versus economic neutrality, batch receipt versus member audit/snapshot artifacts and their later preservation, and destination-budget ownership versus original-anchor vesting; preserve positive controls and score each observation from its own evidence without changing shared scoring policy or timeouts.
